booking.question: How can I book a kayaking trip?
booking.answer: You can make a reservation by phone, through the contact form on our website, or by email. We will get back to you as soon as possible to confirm availability and arrange the details of the trip.

deposit.question: Is a deposit required?
deposit.answer: For larger groups or bookings made well in advance, we may ask for a deposit. Detailed payment information will be provided when we confirm your reservation.

beginners.question: Are the trips suitable for beginners?
beginners.answer: Of course. Many of our routes have a gentle current and are suitable for people kayaking for the first time. We also provide a short briefing before the trip.

instructions.question: Is there a briefing before the trip?
instructions.answer: Yes. Before the trip begins, we provide a short briefing on paddling technique, behavior on the water, and basic safety rules.

children.question: Are the trips suitable for children?
children.answer: Yes, selected routes are suitable for families with children. When booking, it is worth providing the children's ages so that we can recommend a safe and comfortable route.

googleReviews.label: Customer reviews
googleReviews.title: What do our guests say about us?

pawel.text: Great communication, everything was arranged by phone without any problems. I should mention that our group consisted of almost 40 people. The transport logistics and organization of the start and finish were very efficient. A huge plus for the diplomas prepared for the children. But that comes as no surprise, as Mr. Jakub is a cheerful and open person who comes up with various ideas and additional attractions. We wish him continued growth while maintaining the same spontaneity and relaxed but clear communication with customers.

julianna.text: It was absolutely perfect!!! Great price, kayaks, views and river… but what impressed us most was the warmth and kindness of Mr. Jakub!!! I haven't met someone radiating so much kindness in a long time!!! All these exclamation marks are necessary — it was AMAZING!!! Thank you once again.

basia.text: A great kayaking trip and excellent service. Everyone was happy.

magdalena.text: I highly recommend kayaking with Mr. Jakub. The route was selected according to our experience level. Our Żerniki - Mokrsko route, which took around 4 hours, was perfect for families with children. With a stop at the beach for a bonfire and sausages, the whole trip took about 5 hours.

tomasz.text: Fantastic. This is a great idea for tourism in this beautiful region. The Natura 2000 area attracts visitors and this business is a great example to follow. He started with just four old, used kayaks bought very cheaply. Today he has 290 new ones and continues to develop the entire infrastructure whenever possible. The organization is flawless and professional. A 15 km trip costs only 80 zł per kayak. Kraków is four times more expensive. Along the way, you can also visit the knight's castle. Transport back from the marina to the parking area is free. The Nida is an extremely picturesque, clean and shallow river with a gentle current. Families with children and even dogs can enjoy the trip. Highly recommended for hot summer days.

agata.text: Highly recommended. 🙂 Competitive prices and the possibility to choose your own route are definitely a big advantage! 😊😊 The service is also excellent — Mr. Jakub helps you choose a route depending on your kayaking experience and explains how to behave safely on the water. I will definitely come back! 🔥

pawelLacheta.text: Very efficient organization and excellent communication with Mr. Jakub. The kayaks are in good condition and the Nida is a beautiful river. Prices are affordable. I can wholeheartedly recommend it!

piotr.text: Highly recommended. A very individual approach to each customer. I rented a single kayak for a slightly later time, which wasn't possible with the competition.

grzegorz.text: Definitely worth trying. A wonderful time spent with the family. Reasonable prices and easy to find using online navigation. A great kayaking trip.
